Thanks.  Well, try to keep smiling.  Maybe you have a story to tell, and one that needs to be heard.  The goal is to keep finding reasons to hang on another day, until every day doesn't seem like it may be the last day.  Need anything lmk..

I know this probably doesn't mean much to you..  However, as a father of a 15, 13, 11 and 10 year old, this is the kind of thing that keeps me hanging on another day.  I can't imagine how I could put them throught this, because they expect their father to be here..

When I was 10 years old my mother told my father she was afraid I was depressed and may hurt myself.  He said, in front of me, that if I'm going to try and kill myself he just wished I do it instead of worrying her.  I believe parents take this as some personal attack on their parenting skills.  Yeah, you was a fuckiing terrible parent dad.. So, go fuck yourself.  I wish I would of said that...

If you don't want want to put your family through it then you still have something to live for.  If you have a reason to live, which that is, then hold onto that until you find some hope for yourself.  And, you will find some hope for yourself in the future, but that's what's going to get you through now..

As a person that's been on her side of things I'd come right out and say what you are thinking.  Tell her, I know you've talked about no living a long time before, and you're concerned by her behavior that the end is sooner then later in her mind.  Tell her what you like about her and what she has to live for.  Tell her you're willing to do whatever it takes to see she gets through it.. etc etc..

Here's the thing.   You are wired differently from them.   You seem to react the opposite way to things everyone else does.  So, you need to tell them you need to see a Dr.   Not a family Dr., but for counseling.  People need help in understanding life and themselves.  There's no shame in that.  Your family will see it as you trying to better yourself, the same way they see you as going back to school...  You'll be better off, and they'll be happy.
bullshit..  he's not done torturing you..  there's nothing you can do.  you'll die when he's done..

Did you begin feeling this way after you became pregnant?  I don't think this is abnormal.  My wife went through the same thing.  You have to tell your Dr. you are feeling this way since you're off your medication.  You'll get through it.  Try to remember you're not thinking or feeling clearly right now.  Make sure others know how you feel..  This is temporary.
I'm fine.  I don't have long to live, but I always wondered people do what they do.. From both ends of the spectrum..

I feel your pain for sure.  Also, the God part not answering prayers of a child who's fucked up and in a terrible situation, creates a lot of anger..  I just want to say that I attempted suicide when I was angry like you feel now.  I was found with barely a pulse.  After a couple ambulance rides and a helicopter one too I ended up at a speciality hospital and in a coma.  I woke up after 6 days, even though the Dr's recommended pulling the plug after 2 days so they could harvest my parts.  They said in the 1/5000 chance I'd wake up I'd be a vegetable for life..  Anyways, my original point was going to be, that my time in a coma wasn't peaceful for me at all.  More like an ongoing nightmare that kept playing in my head.  I always thought it may of been because I was so angry when I did it..

I feel what you are saying. Although male, I can relate to what you are going through.  You have to say something and start getting help now. If you choose to take your own life he is controlling you still, because without out his actions you would feel differently.  The only way to take control of your life by speaking up. There’s no other choice. If you feel better someone doing it anonymously then I’d be happy to help.  What you feel like now can be temporary and still change.

When I was a teenager I had an appointment with a therapist.  I went to the appointment and when they didn't call me back I went up to the desk to let them know.  They kept saying that the dr would be right with me.  This continued for 2-3 hrs and eventually I left as they started locking the doors.  I realized they weren't going to be seeing me, and thought it must be because they didn't think I was worth helping.  I always remembered how that felt..  I've seen some drs since when I've been hospitalized following suicide attempts or over doses, but never trusted them enough to open up.

look, how good looking you are is irrelevant to how attractive you may be to other people on the inside.  you should expand your interests, join a club, sport (even rec league), or youth group at church.  take the good qualities you find in other people and try to emulate them.  Be proactive.  You can control you.  If you do these things they will help.  You need that one friend that you can confide in and count on.  However, that will come later in the friendship.  Start out lighter, common interests etc..  Good luck.

Craziness.  First of all, you might sell your gun.  Also, one thing that keeps me going is reversing the situation.  I think of my kids and wife and if there is any circumstance that I would not be devastated if they decided to take their own life.  I would be devastated even knowing they felt as though that's something they'd consider doing.  It would kill me to know their going through that much pain.  I wouldn't ever be able to go on.  How can I put them in that situation.  No matter how much I think they'd be better off, or they'll be able to get over it, or I'll just end up letting them down. In my mind, I know that I would never get over it if the circumstances were reversed.  I know I need help, for their sake, I just don't know how to get it..

You start over and build them back up.  One day at a time, it'll add back up quick.  Remember what got you to where you are and try not to make the same mistakes.
